claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street

claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert every evening, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: Free concert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here

notes: Advertisement in Sporting Notes. Text does not say 'saloon'; the place is the one described as a saloon in 924.
